Row.Text: In Sengoku Japan, power belongs to the bold. In the chaos of conflict, the lowliest ashigaru can rise to the title of samurai, and a minor lord can dream of becoming shogun – provided one survives the storm. The time has come to make a name for yourself.

When planning your Buildings, remember that Culture and Science Buildings do not have their normal adjacencies with Sengoku. They do still benefit from Wonder adjacency, but you should save the good terrain spots for other Building types!
